title: Risk Consulting Manager - Financial Services

Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM. As a manager in RSM’s growing Financial Services Risk Consulting practice, you will have the opportunity to draw from your experience and knowledge while continuing to grow your leadership skills through a high degree of client and financial services industry exposure, career development and mentorship opportunities, and a diverse and inclusive culture. The fast-paced and dynamic environment in which we operate will provide you with daily challenges and exciting opportunities. Our advisors help our clients with identifying and prioritizing risk and leveraging process and controls to reduce risk exposure. title: Senior Manager, Order-to-Cash Assurance
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's global order-to-cash (O2C) function is scaling faster than the processes and systems behind it, across direct enterprise contracts, consumption-based commercial models, and third-party cloud marketplaces. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Order-to-Cash Assurance to make sure every order is priced, billed, collected, and recorded correctly, and that we can prove it. You'll be embedded in the O2C Transformation team, working closely with Order Management, AR & Collections, Revenue Accounting, Billing Engineering, and Go-to-Market. You'll design and run the pricing audits and accuracy measures that show us where we leak revenue or create rework, then fix the root cause at the source. You'll be the compliance advocate for global O2C, helping the business find the compliant way to yes, and often improving a process by removing steps rather than adding them. You'll thrive here if you treat accuracy and compliance as design problems and as a service to the business. You are firm when the risk is real, flexible when it isn't, and able to explain the difference. If you're energized by ambiguous, high-consequence operational problems at a company at the forefront of AI development, we'd like to hear from you. Key responsibilities Design and run recurring audit programs across the O2C lifecycle, including pricing audits, contract-to-invoice accuracy, credits, refunds and concessions, and cash application Define accuracy metrics with baselines and targets, such as pricing and invoice error rates, first-pass yield, rework volume, and revenue leakage, and report them in a way teams can act on Trace preserved Create reusable, pre-approved process patterns and guardrails so teams can move quickly without a bespoke review every time, harmonizing globally and localizing only where statute requires title: Lead Workforce IAM Governance Specialist
description: This role is four days onsite at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week Overview: Responsible for leading the development, governance, and continuous improvement of Workforce Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, standards, processes, and controls. Serves as a subject matter expert and strategic partner responsible for advancing IAM governance, regulatory compliance, and modernization initiatives that enhance the organization's security, resiliency, and operational effectiveness. Primary Responsibilities: Lead development and maintenance of enterprise IAM governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures to ensure consistent monitoring, control effectiveness, and protection of workforce identities. Drive the development and evolution of IAM strategy, governance models, policies, and operating procedures in partnership with Cybersecurity leadership, Technology, Risk, and business stakeholders. Evaluate emerging IAM technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to define strategic recommendations and roadmap priorities for IAM governance and modernization initiatives. Design, implement, and oversee IAM governance reporting, metrics, dashboards, and monitoring capabilities to measure risk, compliance, control effectiveness, and operational performance. Prepare and present risk assessments, governance insights, executive reporting, and strategic recommendations to Cybersecurity leadership and governance committees. Serve as the primary IAM governance partner across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk Management, Internal Audit, Compliance, and business leadership teams to proactively identify and mitigate risk. Lead IAM-related audit and regulatory engagements, including coordination of evidence collection, documentation reviews, management responses, issue remediation, and control enhancement activities. Partner with Cybersecurity teams and managers to continuously improve process documentation, governance reporting, performance metrics, and operational maturity. Create and oversee remediation plans, monitor execution against milestones, and provide guidance to stakeholders to ensure timely and effective resolution of identified risks and control gaps. Foster strong partnerships with stakeholders across the organization to ensure successful implementation and adoption of IAM governance processes and controls. Lead strategic IAM initiatives and modernization efforts, including identity lifecycle management, access certification, role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access governance, segregation of duties, and policy exception management. Provide thought leadership, mentorship, and guidance to analysts and project teams while promoting IAM best practices and governance standards across the organization. Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite. Design, implement, maintain, and enhance internal controls to mitigate risk on an ongoing basis. Identify risk-related issues requiring escalation to management. Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand. Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit findings, as well as any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. Scope of Responsibilities: Partners with Cybersecurity leadership, Technology leadership, Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit, external auditors, and business stakeholders across the enterprise. Functions as a recognized IAM subject matter expert, exercising significant independent judgment in determining objectives, approaches, and solutions for complex identity governance, compliance, and risk management challenges. Work is accomplished with limited direction. Serves as a key advisor and escalation point for Workforce IAM governance matters, influencing strategic decisions and driving execution of enterprise IAM initiatives. Demonstrates advanced knowledge across identity governance, access management, privileged access management (PAM), cloud identity, regulatory compliance, and related cybersecurity disciplines. Manager Responsibilities: No supervisory responsibilities. Education and Experience Required: Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years’ relevant work experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 9 years’ higher education and/or work experience inclusive of a minimum 4 years’ work experience in/with the specific Cybersecurity or Technology area and/or team Demonstrated advanced knowledge of IAM principles and compliance requirements. Education and Experience Preferred: Advanced knowledge of SailPoint, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Saviynt, Okta, or comparable IAM and Privileged Access Management platforms.
